### What to Know

- **Evidence limits:** Health sources note that clinical evidence for anti-hangover supplements is limited, and time, rest, eating before drinking, and moderation remain the most reliable ways to avoid severe hangovers.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHEIkXXHJ_8UJympsDp6rv9oRc-QbojC44GVmg0kB9qIMlBuL6L_SSsI5KfVGRxOX7vPIc56aOWvNJvTeJmg1aY_bDvTRVDqLjeGGbxCNbgmQfIUYYagU49kc5a5DqVTYcJ921mnIbc9niOJlA9YLWg0ruslzhVVpvKEJp6)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXgsPvWkdGE38VvdL9pfuFiOVEdDffx6Ck2yhCZ_-nrHjnKAs0d7Km7i4LxdN5t4TPshXtPAW3CVqyOnUYF1JEBuK2oWS5Ktxc8QrES8yZTTJ7E6XJoje9FceQUKo7F8z1Pyx0i0WWfg)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiQEBxCJF12bSiKp6mRmj9qPiGFObDjtPGoDxZsbtDOPO5ylWkwLpQLPIf5yvU8Kvq5XldY7WtsJnaZqbVXZPluMsSl4cF1hI9fZCimd4MTqxRlv8eD2y5d9iYd5CK1Z2fupVjczUUz65gwJ9gcpAvdxHbRdl78HOdLjsG83F4lgsMTRcbUOKL7QqpQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXVJ_uH2tzjVFlR-YSRC9OfmIozz-7_Hcy0p3dhZ0hTETet9nJIf46olfk4RWHsrgWuJ7di5se2qgjga-iZ775jWDw6CK0hNLfgOKKwLjLpkLOgFVOxhNKOX0FLlQpqMXzJ8Il5we4MOwWjq6d3CLmpZI)
- **Medication caution:** Avoid taking acetaminophen (such as Tylenol) with alcohol or for a hangover, as the combination increases the risk of liver damage.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXgsPvWkdGE38VvdL9pfuFiOVEdDffx6Ck2yhCZ_-nrHjnKAs0d7Km7i4LxdN5t4TPshXtPAW3CVqyOnUYF1JEBuK2oWS5Ktxc8QrES8yZTTJ7E6XJoje9FceQUKo7F8z1Pyx0i0WWfg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdgHEIkXXVJ_uH2tzjVFlR-YSRC9OfmIozz-7_Hcy0p3dhZ0hTETet9nJIf46olfk4RWHsrgWuJ7di5se2qgjga-iZ775jWDw6CK0hNLfgOKKwLjLpkLOgFVOxhNKOX0FLlQpqMXzJ8Il5we4MOwWjq6d3CLmpZI)

- **How you plan to use it** (before/during drinking or the morning after)
- **What you need it to work with** (sugar-free, caffeine-free, or vegan preferences)
- **Your budget or format** (single shots, powder sticks, or tea)

items.title: What to Know
items.text: Evidence limits: Health sources note that clinical evidence for anti-hangover supplements is limited, and time, rest, eating before drinking, and moderation remain the most reliable ways to avoid severe hangovers. Medication caution: Avoid taking acetaminophen (such as Tylenol) with alcohol or for a hangover, as the combination increases the risk of liver damage.
